Class CompletionStagePublishers

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.core.async.publisher.CompletionStagePublishers
@Internal public final class CompletionStagePublishers extends Object
Adapts publishers to CompletableFutures without a reactive library, for the CompletionStage counterparts of the publisher based SPIs. Each future subscribes to its publisher right away, and cancelling the future cancels the subscription.

A publisher is subscribed to in the PropagatedContext of the caller, as a thread-local and, for a Reactor publisher, in the Reactor context, and its signals are handled in that context, so that the continuations of the future run in it.

The futures this class creates are owned by the framework: they are new for each call, and cancel(CompletionStage) cancels them. A stage that an implementation of an SPI returned may be shared, a cached one for example, so the framework never cancels it, and ignores its result once it is no longer needed.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • concat

      public static <T> CompletableFuture<List<T>> concat(Collection<? extends CompletionStage<? extends @Nullable List<? extends T>>> stages)
      Concatenate the lists of several stages, in the order of the stages. A stage completed with null adds nothing. The first stage that fails fails the result with its error. Once the result is complete, or cancelled, the futures of this class among the stages are cancelled, and the results of the other stages are ignored.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The item type
      Parameters:
      stages - The stages
      Returns:
      A future completed with the concatenated lists

    • map

      public static <T extends @Nullable Object, R extends @Nullable Object> CompletableFuture<R> map(CompletionStage<T> stage, Function<? super T, ? extends R> function)
      A future of the value of a stage transformed by a function. The future fails with the error of the stage, without the CompletionException wrapper, or with the error the function throws. Cancelling the future cancels the stage when it is a future of this class, and the function is not invoked once the future is cancelled, even when the stage completes.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of the stage
      R - The type of the result
      Parameters:
      stage - The stage
      function - The function
      Returns:
      The future

    • compose

      public static <T extends @Nullable Object, R extends @Nullable Object> CompletableFuture<R> compose(CompletionStage<T> stage, Function<? super T, ? extends CompletionStage<R>> function)
      A future of the stage that a function returns for the value of a stage. The future fails with the error of either stage, without the CompletionException wrapper, or with the error the function throws. Cancelling the future cancels the stages that are futures of this class, and the function is not invoked once the future is cancelled, even when the stage completes.
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type of the stage
      R - The type of the result
      Parameters:
      stage - The stage
      function - The function
      Returns:
      The future
